description: Features, required journeys and coverage status. 'implemented' means the JSON exists and validates; 'verified' means a recorded live run passed on the revision in that run's provenance.json.

features.title: Approver/fulfillment/policy screens denied or empty for an ordinary employee
features.notes: Access mode is shadow: approver and fulfillment screens load (200/302) but offer no actionable rows; enforce mode must deny. Enforce-mode expectations are declared but not exercised live.
missing: direct request to another office's request id

features.title: Request submit, primary approval and fulfillment
features.notes: Submitted and approved requests have no reversal lifecycle and are retained and reported by number.

features.title: Native consumable inventory (read)
features.notes: Requires native consumables.view; no seeded actor holds it, so the journey is blocked with fixtures.unsatisfied-requirements (see suite native-inventory).

features.title: Committee desk and registry for the working office
Committee office/company boundary and role-gated screens
features.notes: Access mode is shadow: registrar-only GET screens (new, transfers, registry, purposes) load for an ordinary employee; enforce mode must deny and is declared but not exercised live. The foreign-committee boundary (404) holds in both modes.
missing: mutation endpoints denied (live probe supports GET only)
private order/declaration file access for another office

features.title: Committee types and rules (company administrator)
features.notes: Requires a company administrator who is also an active member of the working office; the seeded company administrators are not office members, so the journey is blocked with fixtures.unsatisfied-requirements.

features.title: Constitute, appoint, activate, replace, extend, suspend, dissolve
features.notes: Live inspection on 7 October 2026 showed the order wizard stating that no ministry committee rules are active. The order-readiness guard covers this message and required-file validation. No active type is available to complete constitution or amendment flows. A write journey also needs an authorized company catalogue actor, a synthetic signed-file fixture, and a cleanup/retention policy. Do not create a committee type or assign roles just to make this suite pass.
